review_scope: Bounded source/assertion review, not complete clause or ADR certification. Handoff draft statements are superseded by parent findings and gate-results.

selected_adr_reviews.claim: sRGB-to-DeviceCMYK press conversion uses a right-inverse/search as the assumed device default; classic formula is a deliberately different approximation.
selected_adr_reviews.review: Supported by §10.4.2.1's ICC-enabled preference for §10.3 and independent cube/formula comparisons. Tie this to the chosen raster press; it does not establish a universal native printer default.

selected_adr_reviews.claim: Table 57 stated BG/UCR replaces an implicit generation/removal step even though baseline RGB-to-CMYK uses §10.3 route.
selected_adr_reviews.review: Narrow §11.7.5.3's explicit DeviceRGB-to-DeviceCMYK group condition and §10.4.2.4's formulas. Existing path tests demonstrate it. Distinguish this special input from generic ICC B2A conversion.

selected_adr_reviews.claim: With no stated pair the group's CMYK press profile's B2A is the device default; explicit functions use §10.4.2.4 formula instead, but ICCBased CMYK group keeps B2A.
selected_adr_reviews.review: Directly relevant, with profile-vs-function ambiguity. §10.4.2.4 says each device has suitable BG/UCR defaults but names no algorithm; §10.4.2.1 directs ICC-enabled conversions to §10.3, while §11.7.5.3 explicitly requires the current pair for DeviceRGB into DeviceCMYK groups. Existing independent ink-control tests support the implemented split. Keep claims scoped to this RGB-raster renderer and this special group route.

selected_adr_reviews.claim: Conversions into ICCBased CMYK group use that profile's B2A rather than classic §10.4 formula.
selected_adr_reviews.review: Consistent with §10.3 ICC conversion and §10.4.2.1 ranking; DeviceCMYK and ICCBased target distinctions matter.

selected_adr_reviews.claim: Transfer function is attached to marks and applied after compositing at raster output.
selected_adr_reviews.review: CLAUDE.md explicitly includes §10.5 for screen output. Existing transfer tests cover varied pixels and groups. Add supplied independent BG/UCR + transfer fixture to lock conversion ordering.

selected_adr_reviews.claim: Classic §10.4.2 methods not used on ICC-enabled primary conversion branch, where choice remains optional or condition absent.
selected_adr_reviews.review: Keep per-subclause status precise: 10.4.2.2 formulas feed gray/mask paths; 10.4.2.3 CMYK-to-gray is used; gray-to-CMYK and direct 10.4.2.5 are not the selected device route. Avoid aggregate claim that all are wholly unused.
